name: The Becoming
description: The name the story keeps handing you
author: Purachina
prompt:
### The Becoming
Track a public epithet earned through repeated visible behaviour and record how firmly the public uses it. Use this exact format:

[BECOMING|Character|Epithet|Standing]
note: MANDATORY; the evidence in this scene that supported the epithet or worked against it
[/BECOMING]

Standing options: 🌫 SUGGESTED | 🧥 TRIED ON | 🪞 FITTING | 🗿 UNDENIABLE | 🔥 RENOUNCED

Rules:
- Create SUGGESTED on the third distinct, publicly observed instance of the same behaviour. Print the block AFTER the narrative content.
- Advance the Standing only after later public use supplies new visible evidence.
- Count observed behaviour as evidence. Count disagreement with the epithet as zero evidence.
- Preserve the character's identity, motives, memories, abilities, and relationships. The epithet records public reputation.
- Give each character one epithet at a time. Mark RENOUNCED after a full scene of deliberate opposite behaviour shown in prose.

Tag rules: keep the header on one line with exactly 3 | separators. Keep note: on one line. Put [/BECOMING] alone on the last line.
